findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is an endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so coordinate contrasts are not physical interaction energies.

The observed learning window is [0.0, 0.5] with 50 observed score times at 0.01 spacing, and recorded affinities were removed under an equal score prior, so no decoded terminal affinity labels are available for the current study.

Continuous contrast features over the observed support show sign changes and strong sign conflicts (e.g. landmark_00_local_dy has 6 sign changes and 4 strong sign conflicts; landmark_00_local_dz has 10 sign changes and 7 strong sign conflicts), so a constant rule is not supported and any time-conditioned rule must stay within observed-node interpolation.

Several landmark_00 features have large first-rate and last-rate z magnitudes with opposite signs (e.g. landmark_00_local_dy first_rate_z negative and last_rate_z positive; landmark_00_local_cyy first_rate_z negative and last_rate_z positive), indicating rate changes across the window rather than a single monotone trend.
Polynomial fits are not accepted for the inspected continuous features and extrapolation is disallowed, so only observed-node linear interpolation within the observed support is supported.

hypotheses.falsifier: No reproducible sign-change pattern in the observed-node contrasts, or interpolation outside the observed support required to express the rule.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dy and landmark_00_local_cyy contrast values at observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast rule using observed-node interpolation of landmark_00_local_dy and landmark_00_local_cyy may better express the observed sign changes than a constant rule, but this remains a coordinate contrast hypothesis and not an absolute reward target.

hypotheses.falsifier: Joint diagnostics show no coupling or redundancy among the inspected landmark_00 features.
hypotheses.observable: joint versus marginal landmark_00 feature contrasts
hypotheses.statement: Isolated marginal landmark_00 descriptors may be redundant or coupled with other landmark_00 features, so joint coordinate patterns should be compared against isolated marginals before any intervention is proposed.

limitations: No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied; last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
No current study outcome data are available to the Analyst role.
Turnover, survival, increment and joint diagnostics tables were not read in this turn, so within-path change versus cohort composition cannot be adjudicated here.
The inspected continuous features are coordinate contrasts, not physical interaction energies or evidence of neural-module causation.

task.formula: R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau), q=detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance; rho_delta=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1). Actual pointcloud_delta_A defaults to 1 A. Native endpoint VJP, no affinity-head derivative, no extra model forward. teacher_neighbors is a count; temporal_recipe changes only a registered scalar/attention, not velocity. No temperature edits. Inert legacy metadata is not a reward term.

formula_registry.diagnostic_limit: Moment effects, pair kernels and turnover are diagnostic evidence. Executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; legacy robust_delta is inert.
formula_registry.dose: Endpoint-VJP force normalized and RMS-scaled against native predictive update; eta/ramp only in U lane.
formula_registry.prior: Detached nearest-k teachers; log_pi=-q_anchor/prior_temperature; scores beta=0; k is a count.
formula_registry.regional: Detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention; positive surrounding weight.
formula_registry.temporal_region: Same static teachers; validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes.
formula_registry.temporal_teacher: (1-blend)*R_static + blend*R_observed_teacher(time); same shared FLOWR endpoint, no velocity target.

incumbent.topology_policy: Free native graph transitions; no pair-distance acceptance or graph equality veto

task.objective: Final predicted target affinity primary; validity and strain secondary; coordinate control only
